category.name: Connection
category.description: How the XP processor is connected to the dbx ZonePro.

setting.name: Connection Type
setting.description: Select RS-232 (rear-panel serial, 57600 8N1) or Ethernet (TCP port 3804).

setting.name: Serial Port
setting.description: XP serial port wired to the ZonePro RS-232 port. The ZonePro is fixed at 57600 baud, 8 data bits, 1 stop bit, no parity, no handshaking.

setting.name: IP Port
setting.description: TCP port of the ZonePro control service. The factory value is 3804.

setting.name: ZonePro Node Address (2 hex bytes)
setting.description: Network node address of the ZonePro, as two hex bytes. The ZonePro 1260 factory default is 00 20. Must not be set to 00 33 (reserved for the controller).

category.name: Zones
category.description: Output zone setup. Each zone is controlled through its Router (RTE) object. Find the object ID by selecting the router in ZonePro Designer and pressing Ctrl+Shift+O, or from the Network Trace window (Ctrl+Shift+T). The defaults below match the ZonePro 1260 factory default configuration.

setting.name: Zone 1 Router Object ID (4 hex bytes)
Zone 2 Router Object ID (4 hex bytes)
Zone 3 Router Object ID (4 hex bytes)
Zone 4 Router Object ID (4 hex bytes)
Zone 5 Router Object ID (4 hex bytes)
Zone 6 Router Object ID (4 hex bytes)

category.name: Level Scaling
category.description: Raw fader scaling. The dbx protocol guide maps the router master fader as raw 0..415 over -INF..+20 dB, with 215 = 0 dB and 10 raw counts per dB (each 2 dB step = 20 counts). This matches the master fader shown in the ZonePro Designer router editor. If your configuration reports a different device range (the dbx AMX module uses 0..221 for router output levels on some models), adjust the full-scale value here.

setting.name: Fader Full Scale (raw)
setting.description: Raw fader value that 100% maps to (+20 dB). Protocol guide default: 415.

setting.name: Fader 0 dB Value (raw)
setting.description: Raw fader value equal to 0 dB, used for the dB readout variable. Protocol guide default: 215.

setting.name: Counts per dB (raw)
setting.description: Raw fader counts per 1 dB. Per the dbx protocol guide: 10 (0 dB = raw 215, +20 dB = raw 415). Used for the Level Up/Down step size and the dB readout variable.

setting.name: Level Step (dB)
setting.description: How many dB each Level Up/Down press changes the zone output.

setting.name: Power-On Level (raw)
setting.description: Assumed zone level before any command has been sent (the driver is open loop and cannot read the real value).

category.name: Input Gains
category.description: Optional: object IDs of the per-input gain objects (4 hex bytes each, from ZonePro Designer, Ctrl+Shift+O). All input gain objects use state variable 00 00. Leave blank to disable input gain control for that input.
